_source: mattermost/mattermost on 2026-11-04, read from the public GitHub API: the v12.1 changelog PR (#39286), the Database Schema Changes section of its entry, and the PostgreSQL migrations added between v12.0.0 and release-12.1 (SQL trimmed to its first statements). v12.0's own changelog PR (#38589) was closed without merging.

pr.title: v12.1.0, Mobile v2.46, and Desktop v6.4 Changelogs

schema_section:
#### Database Schema Changes
 - The following schema changes are included in the v12.1 release. No database downtime is expected for this upgrade.
   - Added the ``creator`` value to the ``permission_level`` enum type to support the new creator permission level for property fields; an enum value addition with no table rewrite and negligible impact on running systems.
   - Added the ``healthfindings`` table, which stores the findings raised by the Built-in Health Dashboard keyed by a finding fingerprint; a new table with no impact on existing tables or queries.
   - Added the index ``idx_healthfindings_lastseenat`` on ``healthfindings (lastseenat)`` using ``CONCURRENTLY``, so the build doesn't block reads or writes; no downtime expected.
   - Added the partial index ``idx_propertyvalues_groupid_fieldid`` on ``PropertyValues (GroupID, FieldID)`` for rows where ``DeleteAt`` is 0, using ``CONCURRENTLY``, to speed up lookups that filter by group and field; no downtime expected.
   - Upgrading no longer resizes the ``message`` column on ``posts``, ``drafts``, ``scheduledposts``, and ``temporaryposts``, avoiding a long rebuild of the post message search index (``idx_posts_message_txt``) on large installations. New installations still support messages of up to 262,144 characters. Existing installations keep their current maximum post size, which is determined by the existing ``posts.message`` column size. Installations that already applied the resize in v12.0 keep the larger limit.
   - Servers still running 11.10 that use attribute-based access control can again upload and download files and join policy-protected channels and teams against a database upgraded to 12.x, for example during a rolling upgrade: the upgrade no longer drops the ``AttributeView`` materialized view, and a temporary migration rebuilds it from the 12.x attribute options. While any server still runs 11.10, make attribute option changes from a 12.x server.
  - Rebuilt the ``AttributeView`` materialized view as a rolling-upgrade compatibility shim for pre-000216 servers, resolving option names from ``PropertyOptions`` instead of the stale ``Attrs`` blob; old-node reads block briefly during population.

migrations.000230_add_creator_to_permission_level.u: ALTER TYPE permission_level ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'creator';
migrations.000231_create_health_findings.up.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healthfindings (
    fingerprint     varchar(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    code            varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    subject         varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scope           varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    severity        varchar(16) NOT NULL,
migrations.000232_create_healthfindings_lastseenat_: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_healthfindings_lastseenat ON healthfindings (lastseenat);
migrations.000235_create_property_values_groupid_fi: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_propertyvalues_groupid_fieldid ON PropertyValues(GroupID, FieldID) WHERE DeleteAt = 0;
migrations.000242_create_legacy_attribute_view.up.s:
DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS AttributeView;
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW AttributeView AS
SELECT
    pv.GroupID,
    pv.TargetID,
    pv.TargetType,
